subject: microbiology
title: MHC Class I and II, HLA and Antigen Processing

steps.tx: **MHC class I** (HLA A, B, C) displays cytosolic peptides (8 to 10 amino acids) on every nucleated cell to CD8 cytotoxic T cells: proteasome cuts, TAP transports into endoplasmic reticulum, tapasin loads, surface display invites killing when viral or tumour peptides appear. Platelets carry it, red cells do not, neurons whisper it.
steps.say: Class I reports the cell's internal protein life to CD8 executioners.

left.title: Class I pathway
points: TAP1 and 2 transport peptides to ER
Presents to CD8, NK inhibition via KIR

right.title: Class I evasions
points: Tumours lose HLA or beta 2 microglobulin
NK missing self catches the escapees

steps.tx: **MHC class II** (HLA DP, DQ, DR) displays endocytosed external peptides (13 to 18 amino acids) on professional presenters to CD4 helpers: invariant chain guards the groove, CLIP exchanges via HLA DM in endosomes. Its expression is inducible by interferon gamma on many cells in inflammation, widening presentation and autoimmune risk together.
steps.say: Class II reports what the cell ate to CD4 commanders.

left.title: Class II pathway
points: Presents to CD4 on dendritic cells, macrophages, B cells

right.title: Class II regulation
points: Interferon gamma induces on epithelium and endothelium
Defects: bare lymphocyte syndrome type II
Expression on grafts drives rejection visibility

steps.tx: **HLA polymorphism** (thousands of alleles at class I and II loci on chromosome 6, codominant expression, haplotype inheritance) is the population's peptide display diversity, its disease associations (B27 ankylosing spondylitis, DQ2 and DQ8 coeliac, DR4 rheumatoid, B57 HIV control) and transplantation's matching grammar. Linkage disequilibrium keeps ancestral haplotypes travelling together.
steps.say: No two unrelated people share the full display; HLA is immunity's fingerprint system.

left.title: HLA genetics
points: Typing by sequence based methods now

right.title: Disease associations
points: B1502: carbamazepine SJS in Asian ancestry

steps.tx: **Antigen processing cross presentation** lets dendritic cells display exogenous antigen on class I to prime CD8 responses against viruses that never infect them and tumours, the exception proving pathway rules. Proteasome inhibitors (bortezomib lesson) and TAP blockers by viruses confirm by sabotage what processing builds.
steps.say: Cross presentation lets dendritic cells report other cells' infections to CD8.

left.title: Pathway rules
points: Endogenous to class I, exogenous to class II
Cross presentation: exogenous to class I in dendritic cells
Autophagy feeds endogenous to class II

right.title: Processing targets
points: Proteasome in antigen and myeloma biology
Vaccine adjuvants aim at cross presentation

steps.tx: **HLA typing** methods ascended from serology (microlymphocytotoxicity) through PCR sequence specific primers and probes to next generation sequencing allele resolution, serving transplantation matching, disease association and pharmacogenetic screens. Nomenclature (HLA A star 02 colon 01) encodes locus, allele group and protein precisely.
steps.say: Serology named families; sequencing names exact alleles; matching precision follows method.

left.title: Typing generations
points: PCR SSP and SSOP intermediate resolution

right.title: Typing indications
points: Solid organ and stem cell matching

steps.tx: **Transplant matching hierarchy** differs by organ: kidney survival improves with HLA matching (DR weightiest), heart and lung prioritise urgency and size over waiting for matches, stem cell transplantation demands highest resolution matching (10 of 10 alleles) because graft versus host reads every mismatch, and sensitised patients (panel reactive antibodies) wait longest.
steps.say: Stem cell grafts demand allele perfection; hearts cannot wait for it.

left.title: Solid organs
points: Heart lung liver: urgency dominates, matching opportunistic

right.title: Stem cell
points: Haploidentical donors with post transplant cyclophosphamide

steps.tx: **Superantigen and MHC** from the antigens lesson reconnects: superantigens bind class II outside the groove, mitogens bypass it, conventional responses need its peptide. Tumour neoantigens are mutant peptides whose MHC binding predicts checkpoint response, making HLA the silent variable in immunotherapy biomarkers.
steps.say: No MHC binding, no neoantigen response: HLA quietly grades immunotherapy.

right.title: MHC in infection
points: HLA class II and hepatitis persistence associations
Vaccine epitope coverage by population HLA
KIR HLA pairs in NK education

steps.tx: **Minor histocompatibility and ABO** complete graft immunology's vocabulary: ABO antigens on endothelium cause hyperacute rejection when mismatched (universal donor logic inverted for organs), minor antigens (Y chromosome H-Y in female donors) drive chronic graft versus host despite HLA identity, proving class display of any differing peptide can matter.
steps.say: ABO mismatch rejects in hours; minor peptides graft versus host over months despite perfect HLA.

left.title: ABO barrier
points: ABO incompatible protocols desensitise selected kidneys

right.title: Minor antigens
points: H Y antigens: male recipients female graft considerations
GVHD in HLA identical siblings explained
Graft versus leukaemia shares the mechanism helpfully
